biomarkers.name: Chromogranin A, synaptophysin, INSM1
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive for synaptophysin and/or INSM1; chromogranin A may be focal or weaker than in well-differentiated NETs

biomarkers.name: Ki-67
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very high proliferation; supports NEC classification

biomarkers.name: TP53, RB1
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently altered, especially TP53; RB1 loss/inactivation is common but not universal and varies by site
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports NEC biology and helps distinguish NEC from well-differentiated G3 NET at molecular level

biomarkers.name: SSTR2
biomarkers.prevalence: Often low/negative compared with well-differentiated NETs, but expression is variable
biomarkers.clinical_use: DOTATATE PET is often less informative than in well-differentiated NETs; FDG PET is generally preferred. SSA and PRRT are typically less effective

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.prevalence: Present in a subset, particularly colorectal NEC; uncommon overall
biomarkers.clinical_use: Pembrolizumab if MSI-H/dMMR per tissue-agnostic indication

biomarkers.name: NSE, ProGRP
biomarkers.clinical_use: Small-cell-like markers; adjunctive only, not definitive

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Poorly differentiated small cell or large cell NE morphology; NOT organoid growth of well-differentiated NETs

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; MSI-H subset is more likely inflamed and IO-responsive
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Small-cell-like or large-cell pleomorphic; extensive necrosis

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: GI epithelial progenitor cells with de novo neuroendocrine differentiation, or dedifferentiation from adenocarcinoma  distinct from well-differentiated NET lineage
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Poorly differentiated high-grade neuroendocrine  synaptophysin+/chromogranin+ with often reduced SSTR2 expression relative to well-differentiated NETs; small cell or large cell morphology mirroring SCLC/LCNEC
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct lineage biology from well-differentiated NET  TP53 alteration and RB1 loss/inactivation often parallel SCLC; often adjacent to adenocarcinoma component (MiNEN  mixed neuroendocrine-non-neuroendocrine neoplasm) suggesting divergent differentiation from common precursor
